💡 This review uniquely systematizes asymmetric coordination chemistry and dual-atom structures in single-atom catalysts for Li-S batteries, linking geometric configuration, orbital hybridization, and interfacial charge rearrangement to polysulfide conversion kinetics. Advanced Science | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 Hollow graphene-shell spheres are introduced as slurry-compatible pore-engineering additives that accommodate electrode deformation without multistep processing or sacrificial pore formers. They improve thickness recovery, reduce lithiation swelling (15% vs 94%), and retain ~702 mAh g⁻¹ after 400 cycles, while also benefiting SiOₓ/graphite, Si@C, and NCM811 formulations—offering a simple strategy to regulate stress and maintain performance in high-capacity electrodes.
